en.dek: President Donald Trump called for an immediate investigation into third-quarter gross domestic product data after the Commerce Department revised economic growth upward to 4.3 percent.
body: President Donald Trump demanded an immediate investigation into third-quarter gross domestic product figures on Thursday after the federal government revised the growth numbers upward. Writing about the latest report from the Commerce Department, Trump called the updated figures a mistake that requires official inquiry. Reuters reported his demand for a probe, while lower courts and public agencies have not publicly responded to the request.

The Commerce Department released updated economic figures showing third-quarter GDP grew at an annualized rate of 4.3 percent. That measurement increased from an initial government estimate of 3.4 percent, according to reporting by The Hill and The Straits Times. The revised numbers came out in the period preceding the midterm elections.

Trump characterized the revised figures as fake when requesting the government investigation. He did not provide specific evidence of errors in the calculation process when he made the statements. Federal statistical agencies regularly publish revisions to quarterly gross domestic product numbers as additional economic data becomes available.
facts: President Donald Trump called the revised GDP data a mistake and demanded an immediate probe.
The Commerce Department revised third-quarter GDP growth upward to 4.3 percent from an initial 3.4 percent estimate.
Trump characterized the updated economic figures released before the midterm elections as fake.
en.title: Trump Demands Investigation Into Revised Third-Quarter GDP Figures
en.context: Gross domestic product measures the total value of goods and services produced within the United States, and the Commerce Department routinely updates these figures as more complete data arrives.

zh.title: 特朗普要求调查GDP数据

en.headline: Trump calls GDP figures fake
en.body: Trump alleges 'fake' economic figures released before US midterms but doesn't provide evidence. His White House called it a surge in October. Donald Trump expressed concerns over revised GDP figures, claiming they were previously misrepresented before the midterm elections.

fr.headline: Trump qualifie les chiffres du PIB de faux
fr.body: Donald Trump accuse les chiffres économiques 'faux' publiés avant les élections de mi-mandat, sans apporter de preuve. La Maison Blanche avait parlé d'une hausse en octobre. Donald Trump s'est exprimé sur les révisions des chiffres du PIB, affirmant qu'ils avaient été précédemment mal représentés avant les élections de mi-mandat.

de.headline: Trump nennt BIP-Zahlen gefälscht
de.body: Trump behauptet, vor den US-Zwischenwahlen veröffentlichte Wirtschaftsdaten seien „gefälscht“, liefert dafür aber keine Belege. Sein Weißes Haus hatte sie im Oktober als Aufschwung bezeichnet. Donald Trump äußerte Bedenken über die korrigierten BIP-Zahlen und behauptete, sie seien vor den Zwischenwahlen falsch dargestellt worden.

it.headline: Trump definisce falsi i dati del PIL
it.body: Trump sostiene che siano 'false' le cifre economiche diffuse prima delle elezioni di metà mandato statunitensi, ma non fornisce prove. La sua Casa Bianca aveva parlato di un'impennata a ottobre. Donald Trump ha espresso preoccupazioni per i dati rivisti sul PIL, sostenendo che in precedenza erano stati travisati prima delle elezioni di metà mandato.

zh.headline: 特朗普称GDP数据造假
zh.body: 特朗普声称美国中期选举前公布的经济数据是“虚假”的，但未提供证据。他的白宫称十月出现增长。唐纳德·特朗普对修订后的GDP数据表示担忧，声称这些数据在中期选举前被错误陈述过。

ja.headline: トランプ氏、GDP統計を「偽り」と批判
ja.body: トランプ前大統領が、中間選挙前に公表された経済統計を「偽り」と主張し、証拠を提示しなかった。ホワイトハウスは10月の急増と述べた。トランプ前大統領は改訂されたGDP統計について懸念を表明し、中間選挙前に誤って提示されたと主張した。

ko.headline: 트럼프, GDP 수치 조작 주장
ko.body: 트럼프는 미 중간선거 전에 발표된 '가짜' 경제 수치를 주장했으나 증거를 제시하지 않았다. 백악관은 10월 급증이라고 밝혔다. 도널드 트럼프는 수정 GDP 수치에 대해 우려를 표하며, 중간선거 전에 왜곡됐다고 주장했다.

pt.headline: Trump diz que os números do PIB são falsos
pt.body: Trump alega que as cifras económicas divulgadas antes das eleições de meio de mandato nos EUA são 'falsas', mas não apresenta provas. A sua Casa Branca classificou-as como um aumento em outubro. Donald Trump manifestou preocupações quanto aos números revistos do PIB, afirmando que estes tinham sido anteriormente deturpados antes das eleições de meio de mandato.

es.headline: Trump llama a los datos del PIB falsos
es.body: Trump acusa de 'falsos' los datos económicos publicados antes de las elecciones de mitad de mandato, sin aportar pruebas. Su Casa Blanca lo achacó a un repunte de octubre. Donald Trump expresó su preocupación por los datos del PIB revisados, asegurando que fueron tergiversados anteriormente antes de las elecciones de mitad de mandato.

sources.title: Trump Calls GDP ‘Fake.’ His White House Called It a Surge in October

de.body: Präsident Donald Trump bezeichnete die jüngste Revision des Bruttoinlandsprodukts als Fehler und forderte eine sofortige Untersuchung. Nach Angaben von Reuters fordert Trump eine Untersuchung der vor den Zwischenwahlen veröffentlichten GDP-Daten. The Hill berichtet, Trump fordere eine Untersuchung der "falschen" US-GDP-Zahlen und behauptete, das Handelsministerium habe das BIP-Wachstum im dritten Quartal stark nach oben korrigiert von 3,4 auf 4,3 Prozent.
de.headline: Trump fordert Untersuchung der vor den Zwischenwahlen veröffentlichten GDP-Daten

en.body: President Donald Trump on Thursday deemed the latest gross domestic product revision a mistake, claiming that it should be "immediately investigated." According to Reuters, Trump demands probe of GDP data released before midterms. The Hill reports Trump calls for investigation into "fake" US GDP figures, stating the Commerce Department strongly revised GDP growth in the third quarter up to 4.3% from a 3.4% estimate.
en.headline: Trump demands probe of GDP data released before midterms

fr.body: Le président Donald Trump a qualifié jeudi la dernière révision du produit intérieur brut d'erreur, affirmant qu'elle devait être "immédiatement investiguée". Selon Reuters, Trump demande une enquête sur les données du PIB publiées avant les élections de mi-mandat. The Hill rapporte que Trump appelle à une enquête sur les "faux" chiffres du PIB américain, affirmant que le Département du Commerce a révisé fortement la croissance du PIB au troisième trimestre à 4,3 % contre une estimation de 3,4 %.
fr.headline: Trump demande une enquête sur les données du PIB publiées avant les élections de mi-mandat

it.body: Il presidente Donald Trump ha definito l'ultima revisione del prodotto interno lordo un errore, sostenendo che dovrebbe essere "immediatamente indagata". Secondo Reuters, Trump chiede indagine sui dati sul PIL diffusi prima delle elezioni di metà mandato. The Hill riporta che Trump chiede un'indagine sui "falsi" dati PIL statunitensi, affermando che il Dipartimento del Commercio ha rivisto al rialzo la crescita del PIL nel terzo trimestre fino al 4,3% da una stima del 3,4%.
it.headline: Trump chiede indagine sui dati sul PIL diffusi prima delle elezioni di metà mandato

zh.headline: 特朗普要求调查中期选举前公布的GDP数据
zh.body: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周四认为最新的国内生产总值修订是错误，声称应“立即调查”。据路透社报道，特朗普要求调查中期选举前公布的GDP数据。《希尔报》报道，特朗普呼吁调查“虚假”的美国GDP数据，指出商务部将第三季度GDP增长大幅修正至4.3%，此前估计为3.4%。

ja.headline: トランプ大統領、中間選挙前に公表されたGDPデータの調査を要求
ja.body: 木曜日にドナルド・トランプ大統領は、最新の国内総生産（GDP）改訂値を誤りとみなし、即座に調査されるべきだと主張した。 Reutersによると、トランプ大統領が中間選挙前に公表されたGDPデータの調査を要求。 The Hillは、トランプ氏が「偽り」の米GDP統計だと批判し、商務省が3四半期のGDP成長率を3.4%の試算から最大4.3%に強力に改訂したと報じた。

ko.headline: 트럼프, 중간선거 전 GDP 데이터 조사 요구
ko.body: 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 목요일 latest gross domestic product revision을 실수로 규정하며, 즉시 조사돼야 한다고 주장했다. 로이터에 따르면 트럼프, 중간선거 전 GDP 데이터 조사 요구. 더 힐은 트럼프가 '가짜' 미국 GDP 수치를 조사할 것을 요구했다고 보도했으며, 상무부가 3분기 GDP 성장률을 3.4%에서 4.3%로 크게 수정했다고 전했다.

pt.headline: Trump exige inquérito aos dados do PIB divulgados antes das eleições de meio de mandato
pt.body: O Presidente Donald Trump considerou na quinta-feira que a última revisão do produto interno bruto foi um erro, afirmando que esta deveria ser "investigada de imediato". Segundo a Reuters, Trump exige um inquérito aos dados do PIB divulgados antes das eleições de meio de mandato. O The Hill noticia que Trump pede uma investigação aos números "falsos" do PIB dos EUA, afirmando que o Departamento do Comércio reviu fortemente o crescimento do PIB no terceiro trimestre para 4,3%, a partir de uma estimativa de 3,4%.

es.headline: Trump exige investigación de los datos del PIB publicados antes de las elecciones de mitad de mandato
es.body: El presidente Donald Trump consideró el miércoles la última revisión del producto interior bruto un error, afirmando que debería ser 'investigada inmediatamente'. Según Reuters, Trump exige investigación de los datos del PIB publicados antes de las elecciones de mitad de mandato. The Hill informa que Trump pide investigación sobre los 'falsos' datos del PIB de EE. UU., afirmando que el Departamento de Comercio revisó fuertemente el crecimiento del PIB en el tercer trimestre hasta el 4,3% desde una estimación del 3,4%.
